display.purpose: Current governance questions and result-page titles.

title.purpose: Choices, findings, document articles, and compact sections.

shadows.name: active-record
shadows.purpose: Lifts only the current section in the ledger rail.

shadows.name: primary-action
shadows.purpose: Emphasizes cobalt actions that advance or export.

shadows.name: document-sheet
shadows.purpose: Separates the generated bylaws sheet from the application canvas.

shadows.name: dialog
shadows.purpose: Places modal method information above the working record.

motion.name: progress-settle
motion.purpose: Updates the ruled progress track after a decision is recorded.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Effectively removes transitions and animations when reduced motion is preferred.

motion.name: notice-duration
motion.purpose: Keeps transient copy confirmation visible long enough to read.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Advances the current decision or performs the principal export action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; min-height:44px; padding:0 16px; border:1px solid var(--action, #195fca); border-radius:9px; color:#fff; background:var(--action, #195fca); box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(25,95,202,.18); font-family:"Avenir Next",Avenir,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; font-size:.82rem; font-weight:800; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--action-dark, #104a9f); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus, #f0b429); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: Supports import, export, copy, and previous-step actions without competing with the principal action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:42px; padding:0 12px; border:1px solid var(--rule-strong, #8da4bd); border-radius:8px; color:var(--ink, #0a2342); background:#fff; font-family:"Avenir Next",Avenir,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; font-size:.78rem; font-weight:800; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { color:var(--action-dark, #104a9f); border-color:var(--action, #195fca); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus, #f0b429); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background:var(--blue-paper, #eef4fb); }

components.name: Labeled Field
components.description: Collects project metadata with a persistent ledger label.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:6px; color:var(--ink-soft, #40546d); font-family:"Avenir Next",Avenir,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; font-size:.72rem; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:.05em; } .ds-field input { width:100%; height:42px; padding:0 12px; border:1px solid var(--rule-strong, #8da4bd); border-radius:8px; color:var(--ink, #0a2342); background:#fff; font:600 .92rem/1 "Avenir Next",Avenir,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; letter-spacing:0; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color:var(--action, #195fca); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus, #f0b429); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Mode Switch
components.description: Chooses between creating new bylaws and reviewing an existing document.
components.css: .ds-mode-switch { display:inline-flex; padding:3px; border:1px solid #536e8e; border-radius:10px; background:#0d2c50; font-family:"Avenir Next",Avenir,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; } .ds-mode-switch button { min-height:44px; padding:0 14px; border:0; border-radius:7px; color:#cbd7e5; background:transparent; font-size:.82rem; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer; } .ds-mode-switch button:hover { color:#fff; background:#183b62; } .ds-mode-switch button.ds-active { color:var(--ink, #0a2342); background:#fff; box-shadow:0 3px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.18); } .ds-mode-switch button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus, #f0b429); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Selected Decision Choice
components.description: Records a governance choice and exposes its description and recommendation status in one ruled row.
components.css: .ds-choice { position:relative; display:grid; grid-template-columns:24px 1fr; gap:13px; padding:17px 8px; border-top:1px solid var(--rule, #c7d3e0); border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule, #c7d3e0); color:var(--ink, #0a2342); background:var(--paper, #fbfcfe); font-family:"Avenir Next",Avenir,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-choice:hover { background:#f1f6fc; } .ds-choice.ds-selected { background:#e9f2ff; } .ds-choice input { position:absolute; opacity:0; } .ds-choice:has(input:focus-visible) { outline:3px solid var(--focus, #f0b429); outline-offset:2px; background:#fff8df; } .ds-choice-control { width:21px; height:21px; display:grid; place-items:center; border:1.5px solid var(--action, #195fca); border-radius:50%; color:#fff; background:var(--action, #195fca); box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(25,95,202,.12); font-size:13px; } .ds-choice strong { display:flex; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:9px; font-size:.95rem; } .ds-choice em { padding:3px 6px; border-radius:4px; color:#0b5a43; background:#dcefe8; font-size:.64rem; font-style:normal; letter-spacing:.04em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-choice small { display:block; margin-top:5px; color:#52667d; font-size:.82rem; line-height:1.5; }

components.name: Authority Chip
components.description: Names the governing basis of the current question without implying a readiness state.
components.css: .ds-authority { display:inline-flex; padding:5px 8px; border-radius:6px; color:#294664; background:#e3eaf2; font-family:"Avenir Next",Avenir,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; font-size:.74rem; font-weight:800; } .ds-authority:hover { background:#d8e2ed; } .ds-authority:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus, #f0b429); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Recorded Status
components.description: Confirms in words that the current governance decision is recorded.
components.css: .ds-status-recorded { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:25px; padding:0 8px; border-radius:6px; color:#0b5a43; background:#daeee6; font-family:"Avenir Next",Avenir,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; font-size:.69rem; font-weight:800; } .ds-status-recorded:hover { background:#cfe8de; } .ds-status-recorded:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus, #f0b429); outline-offset:3px; }

components.css: .ds-record-margin { width:min(330px,100%); padding:30px 24px; border-left:1px solid var(--rule, #c7d3e0); color:var(--ink, #0a2342); background:#f4f8fc; font-family:"Avenir Next",Avenir,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; } .ds-record-margin > div, .ds-record-margin > section { padding:18px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule, #c7d3e0); } .ds-margin-heading { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; padding-top:0 !important; } .ds-record-margin span { color:#63768c; font-size:.68rem; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:.07em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-record-margin strong { padding:5px 8px; border-radius:6px; color:#0b5a43; background:#daeee6; font-size:.69rem; } .ds-record-margin h3 { margin:13px 0 0; padding-top:13px; border-top:1px dashed #bdcad7; font-size:.78rem; line-height:1.35; } .ds-record-margin p { margin:8px 0 0; color:#40566e; font-size:.79rem; line-height:1.55; } .ds-record-margin:focus-within { outline:3px solid var(--focus, #f0b429); outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview:
DemClubs feels like a public record being completed carefully in real time. The interface is calm, precise, and workmanlike: cool paper surfaces, midnight civic ink, disciplined rules, and annotations that keep authority, readiness, and clause impact beside the decision that produced them. It avoids both campaign energy and legal-tech severity.

The visual hierarchy always serves traceability. A choice is visibly recorded, its effect appears in the document margin, and unresolved work remains legible without being punitive. Controls feel durable rather than decorative; restrained curvature and sparse elevation soften the system without turning it into a generic card dashboard.
keyCharacteristics: One continuous ledger organized by rules and paper tones, not a collection of equal cards.
High-contrast workhorse typography with tabular numerals for progress and counts.
Cobalt reserved for action and selection; status colors always paired with explicit text.
Privacy, source basis, readiness, and draft impact remain visible at the point of work.
Complete English and Spanish states share the same hierarchy and component behavior.

rules.name: The One Action Voice Rule
rules.body: Cobalt means act, select, or advance; it is not ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Status Is a Sentence Rule
rules.body: Green, amber, and vermilion never carry meaning alone; every state includes a plain-language label and contextual explanation.

rules.name: The Vermilion Reserve Rule
rules.body: Conflict color is reserved for genuine conflicts and errors, never routine emphasis.

rules.name: The Interface–Document Divide Rule
rules.body: Sans serif explains and operates; serif renders the bylaws artifact. Do not use the serif for builder controls or navigation.

rules.name: The Counted Record Rule
rules.body: Progress percentages, section counts, and decision numbers use tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Continuous Record Rule
rules.body: Use rules, bands, and adjacent paper tones to organize related work. Do not break the builder into floating dashboard cards.

rules.name: The Margin Follows the Decision Rule
rules.body: On desktop the annotation margin sits beside the current decision; on smaller screens it moves immediately after it rather than disappearing.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: If a rule or paper-tone change can express hierarchy, do not add a shadow.

rules.name: The Filed Edge Rule
rules.body: Controls may be approachable, but they should retain enough edge definition to feel administrative and durable.

dos: Do preserve the continuous ledger: section rail, active decision, and annotated margin should read as one record.
Do keep authority, source basis, readiness, and clause impact adjacent to the governance choice they explain.
Do pair every semantic color with visible status text and, where needed, explanatory copy.
Do keep local persistence, export, deletion, AI consent, method sources, and the disclaimer explicit.
Do use native semantics, a visible gold focus ring, 44px primary targets, reduced-motion support, and bilingual parity.
Do mark incomplete work visibly while still allowing the user to export a working draft.
donts: Don't turn the surface into a generic dashboard of floating cards, detached metrics, or decorative charts.
Don't use cobalt for passive decoration, green for generic positivity, or vermilion for routine emphasis.
Don't hide unresolved decisions, infer policy choices, or make generated prose appear more authoritative than the recorded answer and governing basis.
Don't send imported text off-device before explicit, specific consent.
Don't replace persistent labels with placeholders, icons, color, hover, or untranslated shorthand.
Don't introduce campaign imagery, fundraising visual cues, legal-tech intimidation, or invented endorsement marks.
